title: Self-Hosted Alternatives Stack
summary: A curated list of self-hosted open-source tools for startups, covering office suites, communication, development, design, business operations, and security.

tools.name: Nextcloud
tools.description: Self-hosted file sync, sharing, and collaboration platform with app ecosystem.

tools.name: Collabora Online
tools.description: LibreOffice-based online office suite for document editing and collaboration.

tools.name: ONLYOFFICE Docs
tools.description: Web-based office suite compatible with Microsoft Office formats.

tools.name: Mailcow
tools.description: Dockerized email server suite with webmail, anti-spam, and admin tools.

tools.name: Modoboa
tools.description: Mail hosting and management platform with modern UI.

tools.name: Mattermost
tools.description: Self-hosted team chat platform similar to Slack.

tools.name: Prosody
tools.description: Lightweight XMPP server for decentralized messaging.

tools.name: ejabberd
tools.description: Scalable XMPP messaging server for real-time communication.

tools.name: Jitsi Meet
tools.description: Secure video conferencing platform with screen sharing and chat.

tools.name: BigBlueButton
tools.description: Web conferencing system designed for online learning and collaboration.

tools.name: Penpot
tools.description: Open-source design and prototyping platform similar to Figma.

tools.name: Excalidraw
tools.description: Virtual whiteboard for sketching diagrams and ideas collaboratively.

tools.name: GIMP
tools.description: Advanced image editor for raster graphics.

tools.name: Inkscape
tools.description: Vector graphics editor similar to Adobe Illustrator.

tools.name: Krita
tools.description: Professional digital painting and illustration tool.

tools.name: Gitea
tools.description: Lightweight self-hosted Git service.

tools.name: Forgejo
tools.description: Community-driven fork of Gitea with additional features.

tools.name: GitLab CE
tools.description: Full DevOps platform with CI/CD pipelines.

tools.name: Woodpecker CI
tools.description: Lightweight CI/CD system compatible with Gitea.

tools.name: Drone CI
tools.description: Container-native CI/CD platform.

tools.name: Plane
tools.description: Modern project management tool similar to Jira.

tools.name: Taiga
tools.description: Agile project management platform.

tools.name: OpenProject
tools.description: Project management software with Gantt charts and tracking.

tools.name: Odoo
tools.description: All-in-one business suite including CRM, ERP, accounting, and HR.

tools.name: ERPNext
tools.description: Comprehensive open-source ERP system.

tools.name: Dolibarr
tools.description: ERP and CRM system for small businesses.

tools.name: Outline
tools.description: Team knowledge base and documentation platform.

tools.name: Wiki.js
tools.description: Modern wiki platform with markdown support.

tools.name: BookStack
tools.description: Simple documentation platform with structured content.

tools.name: Obsidian
tools.description: Markdown-based knowledge base (not fully self-hosted, but usable with sync solutions).

tools.name: Vaultwarden
tools.description: Lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password manager server.

tools.name: Bitwarden Server
tools.description: Official self-hosted password manager solution.

tools.name: Keycloak
tools.description: Identity and access management with SSO support.

tools.name: Authelia
tools.description: Authentication and authorization server for 2FA and SSO.
